text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Meno-chan-senpai~ Please give me some training too~

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Then me too! Please train with me, Meno-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a break at the summer training camp,
I looked over to find Fenomeno
surrounded by her juniors.
choice_data_list: (She's really come to be adored, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Compared to before, when they scared everyone around them,
this was massive progress.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it wasn't as though Fenomeno's
own demeanor had changed...
Rather—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, little lady.
Bean-chin's lessons are 500 yen a pop.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: DON'T S-T-A-R-T A B-U-S-I-N-E-S-S!!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Surrounding Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!?
Ahahahaha!
choice_data_list: (This! There are more "voices like this" now!)

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Meno-chan-senpai, Golshi-san is gonna run away again!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
Wait right there, Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Heeeey!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yaaikes?! No, no, don't get mad at meee~~☆

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer A
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that duo is running together again!

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer B
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more, officer!
Catch up, catch up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The factor that shifts Fenomeno's running into a higher gear.
And the catalyst that boosted her approachability from the ground up.
choice_data_list: —Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I take out Fenomeno's autumn race schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Should Fenomeno enter the Tenno Sho (Autumn), where she can run on her preferred course?
Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... Dammit...!
Mame-chin, really now...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Finally, we have you in custody...!
*pant*... *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, you too...!
Please help persuade her...!
choice_data_list: Okay... Gold Ship...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list: Do you want to play with Fenomeno more?
Do you want to play with Fenomeno more?

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Meno
text_block_list.text:
—!
Boss!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haha, the hell?
What're you tryin' to make me do?
choice_data_list: Dig with all your might! The Hole-Digging Contest
Patiently stay underwater! A diving showdown

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond just your core and grip strength, you can have fun building up your lower body muscles too.
That's what hole digging is all about.
choice_data_list: Therefore, hole-digging training will now commence!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...!
Golshi-san, who normally slacks off during training, isâ

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Hehehe...!
If I beat Mame-chin with this...
I'll get her to help me out...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: To dig a pitfall big enough to drop 100 people into...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hah!?
choice_data_list: Go for it, Phenomeno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hah!! I won't lose to you,
Gold Ship-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of them kept digging holes as if competing against one another, giving their whole bodies a workout.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... wheeze...
...Haaah... Boss...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You intend to challenge her by using your match with me... is that it?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: “If you keep acting half-heartedly, you'll inevitably lose to those who take things seriously...!”
choice_data_list: You don't have to feel so responsible, though...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she trains as if competing against others,
Fenomeno's abilities might grow even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was an idea born from such naive thinking, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Fine by me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you don't dive in within five seconds after me,
you lose, Mame-chin.
And you'll have to buy me a sand dollar.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gasp!?
choice_data_list: Phenomeno, don't you lose!
Phenomeno, don't lose!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of them dove into the sea. Competing against each other... into the depths...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... wheeze...
...Haaah... Boss...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I won...!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I was watching! Meno!
Yeah, I was watching! Meno!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Fenomeno's concentration
sharpens even further when facing Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then we should enter a race with Gold Ship again...
Should we change it to the Kikuka Sho—!"
choice_data_list: (This might be good for Meno...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...As for the Boss.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss, does it make you happy
to see me beat that girl?
choice_data_list: Of course! It makes me happy to see how much you've grown!
Of course! Nothing makes me happier than seeing you grow!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I see.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I... I'd be happy if I beat that girl, too.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There is a part of me
that truly wishes to defeat her, sir.
choice_data_list: —! I see...!
—! Oh, I see...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Student number... mnya...
Fenomeno... reporting back...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Fenomeno!?
The futon is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thwump!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Tosen Jordan-san...
She's three generations above me...
and a Tenno Sho (Autumn) champion.........)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Khhh... fhhh...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! You're really wiped out, huh.
...Jordan, grab Meno's legs."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Jeez...
I'm only carrying you as far as your futon, okay?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaah, Fenomeno~~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, everyone.
You mustn't hold up an Umamusume
before her race.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'll be careful!

text_block_list.name: Young Daughter B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Meno, make sure you run cool, okay!
I'll copy you and do my best!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Me too~! Just like you, Senior, I'll give everything my all~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
I shall continue to run as a role model for all of you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Please watch, and see the righteous path!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Waah~ Meno!
Meno~~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (I will keep running. To protect the future of the children.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (As an ally of justice.)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Cuuuuuut!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mame-chin.
Life just ain't that easy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"What the world wants is entertainment!
Excitement! You gotta live more in the moment!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Scene 146, retake!
Let's go all out to make the kids love it!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Officer Meno! Charge!! The giant monster Golshin has arrived!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wha, huh...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Kyahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Scene 73!
The 564 Pirates conquer the vast ocean, baby!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second!
Golshi-san!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Kyahahaha! Hey, hey, what's next?
What happens next!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's a car chase between
the Golshi Phantom Thieves and Officer Fenomeno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on a second—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Do your best! Menou!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, it's gonna explode!
Grab the handlebars! It's hype at max volume!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Kyahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: W-Whoa... w-whoa...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-What's wrong?!
Fenomeno-san?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's a nightmare...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I see... All this time, I was—!
